title: Clear per-page state in the shared navigation lifecycle handler, not just on close
trigger: Per-page state (media, cache, badge, session storage) accumulates across navigations within the same tab because only the close handler clears it
principle: The navigation lifecycle handler (e.g. onTabUpdated with status 'loading') is a shared function for every navigation — clearing per-page state there is the root cause fix, not a symptom patch. Reuse the same clear methods already present in the close handler (onTabRemoved); do not write new code. For in-page content changes that fire no navigation event (SPA episode switch replacing the <video> element), a content-script signal is required because the lifecycle handler never runs.

cases.context: Navigating between episodes in the same tab accumulates media (11 → 22) because onTabUpdated loading only resets the auto-download guard, not media; onTabRemoved already has the clear methods but they are not reused
In-page episode switch replaces the <video> element without changing URL or firing chrome.tabs.onUpdated → the loading branch never runs → media accumulates; a content-script signal is needed

applyFor: Chrome extension onTabUpdated / onTabRemoved lifecycle handlers
SPA route change cleanup — clear state on URL change, do not wait for close
Any per-page state that must reset on navigation (media, cache, badge, session storage)
In-page content changes that fire no navigation event — content-script signal based on element replacement
